reviews.t: Helps keep sore throats and colds away
reviews.x: A co-worker recommended this spray for when you feel a sore throat coming on. She swore by it, saying it will knock out a cold before it starts. Well, so far so good! I spray my throat once with it before bed or in the morning if I feel a scratchy throat. Next day, it's gone! My husband just had a bad cold and I thought I might catch it cause I did feel a scratchy throat a few times. I kept using this and still no cold. I also spray a bit in the water I use to rinse my mouth with after brushing

We did not get well. Then I purchased this product and sprayed it in the central areas of our home. It worked. When my husband coughed, I sprayed the Thieves. When we used the phone, we sprayed the Thieves and in a few days we got better. I will NEVER be without this product in our home again.

reviews.t: I'll never be without this again...
reviews.x: I was introduced to this spray in October by my cousin.  I was on a brief weekend trip and got congested and started coughing - my cousin had me spray it in my mouth before bed and again in the morning.  I felt better the next day, she gave me the bottle to take home.  I got my mom hooked on using it also!  There was one other instance where I used it to prevent becoming sick and it worked - the stuff is amazing!  I won't ever be without this miracle spray again.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it helps them avoid or recover from colds and flu, often by spraying the back of the throat.
Reviewers praise its versatility, using it for cleaning, disinfecting, mouthwash, insect bites, and more.
The scent is widely loved as warm and pleasant, though some find it quite strong.
A few reviewers are disappointed by the packaging and ingredients, citing a plastic bottle and undisclosed alcohol and soy lecithin.
Some reviewers are unsure whether it actually works, even though they like the taste.
